input.sql:
SELECT 'g1' grp, COUNT(*) tot,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) office,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) elec,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) music
FROM items_g1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'g2', COUNT(*),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM items_g2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'g3', COUNT(*),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM items_g3;

Read-only SQLite database with three separate product datasets, each using a

  So reviews join to products on `ref_id` (NOT on `fdbk_g2.item_id`, which can

- Text length: use `LENGTH(body)`; SQLite `length()` counts characters for TEXT.
